sonnet.problem: The opening card says 'The Philistines captured the ark of the LORD in battle'. That names the Philistines before card 5, whose fill-in-the-blank answer is 'Philistines' (the LORD will deliver them 'from the hand of the ___'). The earlier card gives the answer away.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
